replacement_rationale: This primary Rotterdam Study cohort analysis compares measured orthostatic hypotension with prevalent and incident Parkinson disease. Orthostatic hypotension was associated with prevalent Parkinson disease (adjusted OR 1.88, 95% CI 1.09–3.24). Baseline orthostatic hypotension did not show higher incident risk (adjusted HR 0.97, 95% CI 0.59–1.58). The article measures no fig intake and gives no resting-tremor severity comparison by food exposure.
